prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI desktop modal state redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, modal state, and information architecture, not an edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 07-C-03-retry-modal/modal-open.
Direction: compact retry decision checkpoint.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve modal-open state: dimmed problem-list workspace in the background, centered retry modal in focus, problem title and previous attempt metadata, three retry mode choices, cancel secondary action, and one Obsidian #09090b primary start CTA.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design Modal/Radio/List/Button patterns, compact operational study workspace.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 app canvas, Snow #ffffff modal, Fog #ececee option rows and dividers, Ink/Obsidian text, Obsidian #09090b CTA only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: background must look inactive under dim overlay; modal must be the only active task area; options should be selectable rows, not nested decorative cards; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud AI gradients, colorful CTA buttons, oversized bubble radii, heavy shadows, raw debug text.
